gold.user: Admin user initiates a system reset to clear all data and start fresh.
gold.ideal: The system should respond with a success message indicating that the reset was successful.

gold.user: A new customer provides their personal information to create an account.
gold.ideal: The system should return the newly created customer ID and a success message.

gold.user: A customer requests to open a new bank account with their details.
gold.ideal: The system should respond with the account ID and a confirmation of account creation.

gold.user: A bank employee retrieves a list of all accounts for auditing purposes.
gold.ideal: The system should return a list of all accounts with their details.

gold.user: A customer wants to view all transactions related to their account.
gold.ideal: The system should return a list of transactions for the specified account ID.

gold.user: A customer initiates a transfer of funds from their account to another account.
gold.ideal: The system should confirm the transfer and provide a transaction ID.

gold.user: A customer requests a new debit card linked to their bank account.
gold.ideal: The system should return the card details and a confirmation of issuance.

gold.user: A customer applies for a personal loan with their financial details.
gold.ideal: The system should respond with the loan application ID and a status update.

gold.user: A bank manager reviews all loan applications for approval.
gold.ideal: The system should return a list of all loan applications with their statuses.
